{{Top|leg}}
The '''Qieg language''' was spoken by the [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]], an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] race native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. It consisted of clicks and chirps, and included elements of body language such as mandible motions and the waving of antennae. When communicating with non-Qieg, they wore [[electronic mask]]s that were capable of reproducing the vocal range of the [[Human]] voice box. In the Qieg language, "[[Qiemal]]" meant "First Nest."
